label: SPE
description: Arm Statistical Profiling Extension (SPE) 寄存器

registers.name: PMSEVFR_EL1
registers.description: SPE 事件过滤寄存器。定义 SPE 统计的事件类型位掩码。FEAT_SPE 时存在。

fields.name: E[63]
fields.description: [When 事件 63 is implemented and 过滤器ing on 事件 63 is supported] Filter on IMPLEMENTATION DEFINED 事件 63. An IMPLEMENTATION DEFINED 事件 might be recorded as a multi-bit field. In this case, the corresponding bits of PMSEVFR_EL1 define an IMPLEMENTATION DEFINED 过滤器 for the 事件. If FEAT_SPE_FnE is implemented, PMSFCR_EL1.FnE is 1, PMSFCR_EL1.FE is 1, PMSEVFR_EL1.E[63] is 1, and PMSNEVFR_EL1.E[63] is 1, then, for each sampled 操作, it is CONSTRAINED UNPREDICTABLE whether the sample is discarded, and it is CONSTRAINED UNPREDICTABLE whether the SAMPLE_FEED_EVENT PMU 事件 is generated. This field is ignored by the PE when PMSFCR_EL1.FE is 0 [0b0=; 0b1=]
